title: Negative fixture: a trace replay that records only the chosen arm
description: MUST be rejected. Replaying a recorded week through a chosen_only recorder cannot answer 'what if we had routed this differently' -- the arm the policy did not pick has no recorded outcome and no logged propensity, so the counterfactual is not biased, it is missing. #15 can do IPS over a chosen_only trace WITH logged propensities; it cannot do full counterfactual replay, and a scenario that looks like it can is a trap for whoever reads the benchmark table.
